title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
My first few weeks in MDS have been exciting but also stressful. There are many lectures, labs, worksheets, and assignments, and each course covers a lot of material in a short time. I am still getting used to the fast pace and learning how to manage my time better.
So far, I have learned many new topics and tools. In Python and R, I have worked with programming, data manipulation, and data cleaning. I have also studied probability and statistics while learning tools such as Git, GitHub, the command line, and Quarto.
One of my biggest concerns is finding a job after graduation. Since MDS is a short and intensive program, I feel that I need to prepare for the job market while keeping up with my courses. My goal is to become a data analyst, and I hope the skills I learn in MDS will help me achieve that goal.

title: About Me
text:
Why Data Science
I chose to pursue data science because I enjoy working with data and discovering useful information from it. Through the MDS program, I hope to strengthen my skills in programming, statistics, machine learning, and data analysis. After graduation, my goal is to work as a professional data analyst and use data in AI industry explicitly.

title: About Me

Outside Data Science
Outside of academics and data science, I am passionate about DJing and breaking. I enjoy music, dancing, and the creativity that comes with both of these activities. In fact, I am a competitive breakdancer and have competed in several competitions—although I haven’t won any awards yet!
